sentence: The desktop version of ChatGPT's built-in browser now supports WebMCP, a standard that instructs AI on how to use website features like purchasing products, reserving seats, and searching for information.
With this integration, ChatGPT and Codex can automatically perform tasks on compatible websites.
The ChatGPT Sites feature—which enables building websites through ChatGPT—now also supports creating WebMCP-compatible sites.
